# openac

openac provides R wrappers around external, open-source
affective-computing tools — ffmpeg/ffprobe, OpenFace, openSMILE, and
Whisper (via audio.whisper) — so researchers can run them from a single,
consistent R interface. It covers tool discovery, installation, and
configuration; audio/video preparation; single-file and batch extraction
(with parallelism and progress); and reading each tool’s output into a
tidy tibble.

## Installation

You can install the development version of openac from
[GitHub](https://github.com/jmgirard/openac) with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("jmgirard/openac")
```

openac calls external command-line tools; install and register the ones
you need
(e.g. [`install_opensmile_mac()`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/install_opensmile_mac.md)
/
[`install_opensmile_win()`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/install_opensmile_win.md),
or point openac at an existing install with
[`set_opensmile()`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/set_program.md)).

## Example

Extract acoustic features from a folder of audio files in parallel, then
read one result into a tidy tibble:

``` r

library(openac)

# Extract eGeMAPS features from every .wav under audio/ into features/.
os_extract_dir(
  indir = "audio",
  inext = "wav",
  aggdir = "features",
  config = "egemaps/v02/eGeMAPSv02"
)

# Read one aggregate output into a one-row-per-file tidy tibble.
feats <- os_read("features/clip01_agg.csv")
```

## Using openac alongside tidymedia

openac and [tidymedia](https://github.com/jmgirard/tidymedia) both wrap
ffmpeg/ffprobe, and both export these eight names:

`ffm`, `ffmpeg`, `ffprobe`, `find_ffmpeg`, `find_ffprobe`, `set_ffmpeg`,
`set_ffprobe`, `set_program`

Attaching both packages masks one set with the other, decided by attach
order, with no warning beyond R’s masking message. Six of the eight
behave differently between the packages, so a masked call can succeed
and do the wrong thing:

- **`ffm` is the sharpest.** In openac it is an alias for
  [`ffmpeg()`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/ffmpeg.md)
  and returns the tool’s output. In tidymedia it constructs a command
  object and runs nothing.
- **The `find_*` and `set_*` pairs read and write different
  configuration directories.** A tool location recorded with
  [`openac::set_ffmpeg()`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/set_program.md)
  is invisible to `tidymedia::find_ffmpeg()`, and the reverse. Register
  each tool in each package you use it from.
- **[`set_program()`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/set_program.md)
  accepts different program names** in each package.

If you need both, qualify the calls —
[`openac::ffmpeg()`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/ffmpeg.md),
`tidymedia::ffm()` — rather than relying on attach order. (Observed
against tidymedia at commit `b99f7e8`, 2026-08-08; the two name sets are
compared in full in `cairn/references/tidymedia-fit.md` in this
repository.)

# Package index

## Package

- [`openac`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/openac-package.md)
  [`openac-package`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/openac-package.md)
  : openac: Open Affective Computing Tools

## Program management

Locate, register, check and install the external command-line tools
openac drives. Locations are discovered on the PATH or recorded per
tool; nothing is hard-coded.

- [`find_program()`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/find_program.md)
  [`find_ffmpeg()`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/find_program.md)
  [`find_ffprobe()`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/find_program.md)
  [`find_openface()`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/find_program.md)
  [`find_opensmile()`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/find_program.md)
  : Find the location of a dependency program
- [`set_program()`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/set_program.md)
  [`set_ffmpeg()`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/set_program.md)
  [`set_ffprobe()`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/set_program.md)
  [`set_openface()`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/set_program.md)
  [`set_opensmile()`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/set_program.md)
  : Set the location of a dependency program
- [`check_ffmpeg()`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/check_ffmpeg.md)
  : Check that ffmpeg is accessible
- [`check_ffprobe()`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/check_ffprobe.md)
  : Check that ffprobe is accessible
- [`check_openface()`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/check_openface.md)
  : Check that openface is accessible
- [`check_opensmile()`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/check_opensmile.md)
  : Check that opensmile is accessible
- [`install_ffmpeg_win()`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/install_ffmpeg_win.md)
  : Install FFmpeg on Windows
- [`install_openface_win()`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/install_openface_win.md)
  : Install openface on Windows
- [`install_opensmile_mac()`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/install_opensmile_mac.md)
  : Install openSMILE on macOS
- [`install_opensmile_win()`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/install_opensmile_win.md)
  : Install openSMILE on Windows
- [`install_whisper()`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/install_whisper.md)
  : Install audio.whisper package

## ffmpeg and ffprobe

Low-level argument passthroughs for media transcoding and probing, plus
the stream count openac’s own guards rely on.

- [`ffmpeg()`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/ffmpeg.md)
  [`ffm()`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/ffmpeg.md) :
  Low-level access to the ffmpeg command line interface
- [`ffprobe()`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/ffprobe.md)
  [`ffp()`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/ffprobe.md) :
  Low-level access to the ffprobe command line interface
- [`ffp_count_streams()`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/ffp_count_streams.md)
  : Count the streams in a media file

## OpenFace

Facial-behavior feature extraction, per file and per directory.

- [`openface()`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/openface.md)
  [`of()`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/openface.md) :
  Low-level access to the openface command line interface
- [`of_extract()`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/of_extract.md)
  : Extract openface features
- [`of_extract_dir()`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/of_extract_dir.md)
  : Run of_extract() on multiple files in a directory

## openSMILE

Acoustic feature extraction — config discovery, audio preparation, and
extraction per file and per directory.

- [`opensmile()`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/opensmile.md)
  [`os()`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/opensmile.md) :
  Low-level access to the opensmile command line interface
- [`os_list_configs()`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/os_list_configs.md)
  : List openSMILE configuration files
- [`os_check_config()`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/os_check_config.md)
  : Resolve an openSMILE config name to an absolute path
- [`os_check_audio()`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/os_check_audio.md)
  : Check if an audio file is ready for analysis by openSMILE
- [`os_prep_audio()`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/os_prep_audio.md)
  : Prepare an audio stream for analysis by opensmile
- [`os_prep_audio_dir()`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/os_prep_audio_dir.md)
  : Run os_prep_audio() on multiple files in a directory
- [`os_extract()`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/os_extract.md)
  : Extract opensmile features
- [`os_extract_dir()`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/os_extract_dir.md)
  : Run os_extract() on multiple files in a directory

## whisper

Speech transcription via audio.whisper — audio preparation, model fetch,
and transcription per file and per directory.

- [`aw_check_audio()`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/aw_check_audio.md)
  : Check if an audio file is ready for analysis by Whisper
- [`aw_prep_audio()`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/aw_prep_audio.md)
  : Prepare an audio stream for analysis by Whisper
- [`aw_prep_audio_dir()`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/aw_prep_audio_dir.md)
  : Run aw_prep_audio() on multiple files in a directory
- [`aw_get_model()`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/aw_get_model.md)
  : Get a Whisper model from a local or online source
- [`aw_transcribe()`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/aw_transcribe.md)
  : Transcribe an audio stream using the specified Whisper model
- [`aw_transcribe_dir()`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/aw_transcribe_dir.md)
  : Transcribe multiple media files with Whisper

## Tidy readers

Turn one tool’s raw output into a tidy tibble under one shared contract.
Each reader states its row grain in its first sentence.

- [`os_read()`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/os_read.md)
  : Read openSMILE output into a tidy tibble
- [`of_read()`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/of_read.md)
  : Read OpenFace output into a tidy tibble
- [`aw_read()`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/aw_read.md)
  : Read a Whisper transcription into a tidy tibble

## Parallelism and progress

Re-exported controls so batch runs can be configured without attaching
the upstream packages.

- [`plan`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/plan.md) :
  Re-export the plan function from the future package
- [`handlers`](https://jmgirard.github.io/openac/reference/handlers.md)
  : Re-export the handlers function from the progressr package
